# 公開台本｜Screenplay Reader - AI Agent Guide

[公開台本｜Screenplay Reader](https://open-scripts.shawnup.com) is a platform for writers to publish and share screenplays.
AI-friendly endpoints are provided so you can read scripts without parsing React HTML or executing JavaScript.

## Preferred endpoint for raw content

GET /api/public-scripts/{script_id}/raw

- Returns text/markdown
- {script_id} is the unique identifier found in the public URL: https://open-scripts.shawnup.com/read/{script_id}
- Private or missing scripts return 404

## Preferred endpoint for structured metadata

GET /api/public-scripts/{script_id}

- Returns application/json

## Content negotiation (backend direct only)

When hitting the API backend directly (not the public nginx URL), GET /read/{script_id} with Accept: text/markdown
or a recognized AI bot User-Agent (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Anthropic, PerplexityBot) returns raw markdown.
The public site URL (https://open-scripts.shawnup.com/read/{script_id}) routes through Next.js and returns HTML.
Prefer /api/public-scripts/{script_id}/raw for reliable raw content access.

## Machine Discovery

- API catalog: [/.well-known/api-catalog](https://open-scripts.shawnup.com/.well-known/api-catalog) — application/linkset+json
- Sitemap: [sitemap.xml](https://open-scripts.shawnup.com/sitemap.xml)
- This file: [/llms.txt](https://open-scripts.shawnup.com/llms.txt) and [/.well-known/llms.txt](https://open-scripts.shawnup.com/.well-known/llms.txt)

## Public URL Patterns

- Script page: https://open-scripts.shawnup.com/read/{script_id}
- Author page: https://open-scripts.shawnup.com/author/{author_id}
- Organization page: https://open-scripts.shawnup.com/org/{org_id}
- Series page: https://open-scripts.shawnup.com/series/{series_name}
- Tag page: https://open-scripts.shawnup.com/tag/{tag_name}

## Unsupported Protocols

OAuth, OIDC, MCP, WebMCP, agent skills, and commerce discovery are not currently exposed.

## Notes

- Use /api/public-scripts/{script_id}/raw first; do not rely on parsing rendered HTML.
- Public scripts return 200. Private or missing scripts return 404.
- Unauthorized AI model training on licensed content is not permitted where content terms restrict it.
